mechanism.scope: Temporal calculation inside _transient_heat_modes plus private time/rate helpers; qualified spatial sampler unchanged.
mechanism.represented_scale: S_n=Fraction(alpha)*Fraction(time)*abs(n)^2/Fraction(length)^2 from accepted binary64 scalars and validated integer n.
mechanism.ordinary: Preserve existing arithmetic order and results when dimensional product, squared length, quotient, squared frequency, exponent, rate and CN ratio are normal finite.
mechanism.continuum: H=S_n*Fraction(math.pi)^2; render once for exponential. H beyond binary64 gives zero attenuation.
mechanism.discrete: K=H*Fraction(sinc(y))^2, y=pi*(abs(n)/C)/2 using bounded integer ratio; finite final rendered K retains original M=max(minimum_steps,ceil(max(K))).
mechanism.cn: Ordinary ratio/log1p order retained. Exceptional ratio or integer-step conversion uses exp(-K*atanh(r)/r), r=K/(2M), with removable limit1 and correction bounded by r^2/[3(1-r^2)].
mechanism.shared_steps: Exceptional CN propagation applies to every mode, including an ordinary low mode when another mode forces large shared M.
mechanism.zeros: Time0 or harmonic0 structurally yields unit damping; no dimensional product is required to establish it.
mechanism.range: Unrepresentable positive final scheduling rate follows the existing explicit refusal, with no partial solution or claim_check; no cap or substitute step count.
